newsitem.title: FINLAND: FOREST SECTOR FUELS FINNISH MARCH INDUSTRY OUTPUT.
newsitem.headline: FOREST SECTOR FUELS FINNISH MARCH INDUSTRY OUTPUT.

text.p: Buoyant growth in forest industry output boosted Finnish industrial production to an 8.8 percent year-on-year rise in March from a revised 7.1 percent rise in February, Statistics Finland said on Thursday.
"Forest and paper output rose almost 16 percent in March," Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement.
Pulp and paper production increased 17 percent year-on-year, partly due to the low level of output in the year-ago period.
Wood products output grew over 13 percent, SF said.
Construction materials output grew more than 19 percent, and furniture production rose as much as 25 percent, SF said.
Metal industry output remained strong, increasing over 10 percent in March year-on-year, it said.
Within the metal industry, the fastest output growth was in electro-technical products, up 14 percent, and machinery and equipment, up 13 percent, SF said.
The wood products and paper industry's capacity utilisation rate was above 92 percent, while the metal industry's utilisation rate was over 87 percent, SF said.
